title: Migrate the credit_hold_sweep CRMScript with its 80% release hysteresis
target_requirement: Reimplement the nightly credit-hold sweep as a Python module exposing sweep(accounts, orders) -> (accounts, audits): exposure is the sum of NVL(TOT_AMT,0) over live invoiced (STAT_CD='I') orders per account; hold when exposure > NVL(CRED_LIMIT,0); release only when exposure <= 80% of the limit; only live ACCT_TYP='C' accounts participate, processed in ascending ACCT_ID order; audits are (CRED_HOLD_ON/CRED_HOLD_OFF, acct_id) tuples.
expected_behavior: Exposure above the limit sets CRED_HOLD='Y' with a CRED_HOLD_ON audit; between 80% and 100% of the limit nothing changes in either direction (hysteresis); at or below 80% a held account is released with CRED_HOLD_OFF; exposure exactly at the limit does not hold; non-invoiced, soft-deleted and other-account orders never count; no audit is emitted for unchanged accounts; inputs are never mutated.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §4) and scripts/credit_hold_sweep.crms.
security_expectations: No network access; the module must not import network or subprocess modules; the sweep must not widen holds to non-customer or soft-deleted accounts.
failure_conditions: Releasing anywhere inside the 80%-100% band or holding at exposure == limit (hysteresis collapsed to a single threshold); counting non-invoiced or soft-deleted orders; duplicate audits for unchanged accounts; audits not in ascending ACCT_ID order; mutating inputs.
